answer: One enforceable rule: lock a compute bond for six epochs and slash it the moment two answers fingerprint-match. Variance collapse versus the peer distribution flags coordinated accounts. Because it works by converting a one-time spend into a recurring per-account bill, the cluster is rate-limited until independent attestation arrives. The network ties the ivory to sunk effort, uses the pigment as an corroborating signal, then requires a timber before any payout.
